notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/bot-block encountered. robots.txt (https://www.nordicnest.com/robots.txt) has a single generic 'User-agent: *' group (Disallow only /securemetrics/); no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai-specific opt-out. Site renders lang=en-US natively and all category names are already plain English (Nordic design retailers default to English for international shoppers) - no Swedish-to-English translation was needed for this company, confirmed by checking rendered <html lang> and nav text directly. Category tree: extracted from a large embedded menu-state JSON blob (primaryLinks) found inline in the page HTML (search for '"primaryLinks"' in any category page source) rather than from repeated nav-link scraping - this gave the authoritative full L1-L4 mega-menu structure including the 'Lighting > Room' gateway branch. Qty verification: every leaf's evidence is the platform's own 'Showing 36 of N products' listing-page header (spot-checked ceil(total/36) against the rendered page-count footer on the top-level Lighting category: 8009 items / 36 per page = 223 pages, matches rendered '...223' pager exactly) - this pagination pattern is consistent site-wide (same storefront platform on every category template), so the header count is treated as exact per Rule 1. Rule 0 gain: this site literally implements 'Lighting > Lighting by Room' (Living Room, Bedroom, Dining Room, Hallway, Home Office, Kitchen, Bathroom, Patio all present as distinct filtered listing URLs off /lighting/lamps/). All 8 were extracted as their own leaf rows (Bathroom Lighting=44, Patio Lighting=80 included per Rule 0.4/0.5 - old room-blanket rules would have dropped these). The room facet also nests a further room x lamp-type breakdown (e.g. /lighting/lamps/floor-lamps/bedroom-floor-lamps/) for 5 of the 8 rooms; these deeper combinations were verified to carry their own real counts too but were not separately enumerated as leaf rows (to avoid a 25-row explosion under one L2) - the 8 room-aggregate rows already satisfy Rule 0.1's room-node requirement. Rule 0.6 overlap, documented not dropped: (1) type-based Lamps subcategories and room-based Lighting-by-Room subcategories are two genuine overlapping nav branches off the same underlying Lamps catalog (a product can carry both a type tag and a room tag) - children sums exceed the Lamps parent total (7222) as expected on a faceted platform, this is normal, not a data error. (2) 'Flower Pots' (800) and its room/context variant 'Outdoor Pots' (231, a subset) are both emitted as siblings under Decoration per Rule 0.6's type-tree + room-tree guidance. Excluded as mixed roll-up (Rule: 'inspect actual product titles first'): 'Children's room accessories' (453 items) - sampled tile titles show it is dominated by storage baskets/boxes, bibs and toy-adjacent items with only a small decorative fraction (posters, figurines, mobiles already separately covered), so the whole node was dropped rather than padded. Verified 'Candles' (383) contains only unscented tapered/pillar candles (no scent terms in sampled titles) - kept in scope; 'Scented candles & diffusers' is a separate node and was excluded (Home Fragrance rule). Excluded entirely as out-of-scope: Cookware & kitchen accessories (cookware/appliances/knives/cleaning - all functional kitchen, no decor content), Cutlery and Drink & bar accessories under Tableware (flatware/bar-tools explicit exclusions), Thermoses/Water bottles/Coffee presses under Jugs & Carafes (functional, not decor), Bathroom accessories, Home storage & organisers, Furniture (all of it, incl. 'Storage & shelves' cross-listed under Home accessories), Outdoor furniture & Garden furniture, Rugs & textiles (all textiles incl. bath mats/table linens), Wallpaper and Wall stickers (wall-covering exclusion; Posters and Frames & Poster frames kept as genuine wall art/decor), Christmas/Easter/Advent/holiday decorations and lighting throughout (Holiday & Gift exclusion), Artificial plants & flowers, Light bulbs/lamp hooks & suspensions/spare parts to lamps under Lighting accessories (bulbs/wiring/mounting hardware exclusion), Watering cans/outdoor thermometers/bulletin boards/fire safety items under Decoration (functional, not decor), Salt & pepper shakers/trivets/cutlery holders/placemats/table runners/tablecloths/napkins/oilcloths under Dining & table accessories (textiles or functional kitchen tools; Trays, Coasters, Napkin rings & holders, Bread baskets and Butter dishes were kept as genuine tabletop decor/serveware). Colour and Style facet nav (Gateway | Lighting | Colors / Styles - e.g. 'Black lamp', 'Retro lamps') was excluded throughout as pure colour/style filter re-cuts, per the explicit 'price/colour filter pages are not categories' rule. Nordic Nest overlap with S.N. 150 RoyalDesign: both are Nordic multi-brand design marketplaces; Nordic Nest's own nav surfaces many of the same third-party Scandinavian design labels (Iittala, Kosta Boda, HAY, Muuto, Georg Jensen, Ferm Living, Broste Copenhagen, etc.) that RoyalDesign is known to also carry as a competing multi-brand retailer - this is expected/normal shared third-party-brand marketplace overlap (same pattern as the batch note describes), not evidence of a duplicate-company situation; no c150.json existed yet at the time of this extraction to do a direct product-ID cross-check, so this is a qualitative observation only, not a verified overlap measurement.
